Biography

Gus Bilirakis was born in Gainesville, Florida. He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Florida in 1986 and a law degree from Stetson Law School in 1989.[1] Bilirakis owned a law practice focused on estate planning. He served on the board of Lighthouse for the Blind, as a member of the Rotary Club, and as a member of his local chamber of commerce.[2]
